title: PgBouncer features (paraphrase)
text: PgBouncer is an external connection pooler for PostgreSQL with session, transaction and statement pooling modes. In transaction pooling, a server connection is returned to the pool after each transaction, so session-level features such as SET, LISTEN and session advisory locks cannot be used reliably.
